# Innovation. Service. Integrity.

As leaders in building materials innovation, ISI Building Products manufactures cutting-edge vapor
barrier, insulation and building wrap brands. The design and ingenuity of these products reflects
our mission: to create impactful solutions for building and construction challenges.
* ## Vapor Barrier
* ## Insulation
* ## Building Wrap
* ## Private Label

### Building Envelope Solutions

With corporate headquarters in East Peoria, IL and manufacturing facilities throughout the Midwest,
ISI is a building products manufacturer catering to construction customers throughout North America.
Our centralized operations and strategically placed warehousing allow for efficient distribution to
locations in the US, Canada and Mexico.

Operating since 1997, ISI is proud of the loyalty and level of trust we have earned from respected
vendors, distributors, contractors and clients. As a leading building material manufacturer in the
USA, we are committed to providing high-performance products for the construction industry and
custom, quality solutions for our customers — with the service to back it up.

### Innovative Materials Engineering

As a top building material supplier, ISI helps create energy efficient, weather-protected homes and
buildings. We believe our products are only as good as what goes into them.

 Our research and development process starts with customer feedback. Using our industry expertise,
we find ways to utilize the finest materials and manufacturing technologies to provide high caliber,
market-leading products. Attention to detail and technical expertise helps us stand out among
construction material suppliers.

### Custom & Private Label Manufacturing

In addition to a wide-ranging product line, our extensive manufacturing capabilities allow us to
provide custom designs for unique applications as well as customer-specific labeling, color, styles,
sizes and configurations. As your custom building products partner, we take pride in manufacturing
construction and building materials that meet and exceed the changing needs of the construction
industry. Browse and discover the wide variety of high quality products ISI currently offers.
Contact us for any ideas, applications or products not listed. Always looking for opportunities to
expand our core capabilities, we will work to find you the solution.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Which Insulation do I Need?

At **Aerolam**, we offer a wide range of insulation solutions, including **XLPE Insulation, Bubble
Insulation,** and **Pre-Insulated Sheets (Aerocomfort).** The right insulation depends on your
application—whether it’s for HVAC systems, industrial buildings, or residential projects. Our team
can assist you in selecting the most appropriate product based on thermal, acoustic, and
environmental requirements.

What is k-Value?

The k-value refers to a material’s thermal conductivity. A lower k-value means the insulation is
more effective in restricting heat transfer. Aerolam’s insulation products are designed with low
k-values, ensuring superior thermal performance and energy efficiency.

What is the Importance of Vapour Resistance Value?

Vapour resistance is crucial in preventing moisture ingress, which can cause condensation, mould
growth, and reduce insulation efficiency. Aerolam insulation products offer excellent vapour
resistance, making them ideal for humid environments and HVAC ducting applications.

What are the Benefits of Insulation?
* Insulation from Aerolam provides multiple benefits:
* Enhanced energy efficiency
* Lower heating and cooling costs
* Improved indoor comfort
* Noise reduction
* Condensation control
* Fire resistance and sustainability
How Long does Insulation Last?

Aerolam insulation products are manufactured using high-quality, durable materials.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Which Insulation do I Need?

At **Aerolam**, we offer a wide range of insulation solutions, including **XLPE Insulation, Bubble
Insulation,** and **Pre-Insulated Sheets (Aerocomfort).** The right insulation depends on your
application—whether it’s for HVAC systems, industrial buildings, or residential projects. Our team
can assist you in selecting the most appropriate product based on thermal, acoustic, and
environmental requirements.

What is k-Value?

The k-value refers to a material’s thermal conductivity. A lower k-value means the insulation is
more effective in restricting heat transfer. Aerolam’s insulation products are designed with low
k-values, ensuring superior thermal performance and energy efficiency.

What is the Importance of Vapour Resistance Value?

Vapour resistance is crucial in preventing moisture ingress, which can cause condensation, mould
growth, and reduce insulation efficiency. Aerolam insulation products offer excellent vapour
resistance, making them ideal for humid environments and HVAC ducting applications.

What are the Benefits of Insulation?
* Insulation from Aerolam provides multiple benefits:
* Enhanced energy efficiency
* Lower heating and cooling costs
* Improved indoor comfort
* Noise reduction
* Condensation control
* Fire resistance and sustainability
How Long does Insulation Last?

Aerolam insulation products are manufactured using high-quality, durable materials.

## Thermal Runaway
## Is a Chain Reaction

When a single lithium-ion cell fails, it can release extreme heat — rapidly propagating to
neighboring cells and triggering a cascading thermal event that endangers the entire battery system.

01

#### Cell-Level Failure

Internal short circuit or defect causes rapid temperature rise exceeding 400°C within a single cell.

02

#### Heat Propagation

Without adequate barriers, thermal energy conducts to adjacent cells through direct contact and hot
gas venting at 350°C+.

03

#### Cascading Failure

Multiple cells enter thermal runaway, creating an uncontrolled exothermic event with risk of fire
and explosion.

**Levron Aerogel Felt withstands 1000°C direct flame exposure** — even at just 2cm thickness, it
outlasts 5cm rock wool + 4cm glass wool combined. Passive thermal protection as the last line of
defense.

#### Why Do Lithium-Ion Batteries Burn?

Li-ion batteries contain liquid electrolyte separated by thin semi-permeable separators. During
overcharging, cycling, or mechanical deformation, cells can overheat past the critical 170°C
threshold — igniting the electrolyte, which generates its own oxygen and creates self-sustaining
jet-flame combustion that conventional methods cannot extinguish.

165° contact angle

layers.

700+ m² per gram

Reflective insulation is an insulating and energy conserving product that adds an air cushion,

# Why Insulation is Important

[Alutix Insulation]

Insulation means protecting an area from heat. Traditional insulation methods like fiberglass or
metal can protect your premise form convection & conduction heat but are ineffective against radiant
energy, which causes green house effect in your premises but also affects the overall atmospheric
temperature.

Keeping these factors in mind , it is important to choose the right kind of insulation for your
premises. with 96% reflection ratio, thermal insulations are the most preferred kind of insulations
available in the market today.

## Why Alutix Insulation?

At Alutix, we produce Aluminium Air Bubble Insulation, which reflect(block) the radiant energy to
enter in your premise & thus help you maintain the temperature inside. Our manufacturing unit is
located in Raipur , Chhaattigarh.

The state of the art plant boasts of the world's finest thermal insulation manufacturing machines
with High-Speed production facility backed by the dedicated and experienced teams of motivated
members.

Our production process uses the most efficient method of manufacturing insulation material which
helps us to offer superior & consistent quality products at a competitive price.

insulating value or R-value of what would otherwise be a simple radiant barrier.

# Why Insulation is Important

[Alutix Insulation]

Insulation means protecting an area from heat. Traditional insulation methods like fiberglass or
metal can protect your premise form convection & conduction heat but are ineffective against radiant
energy, which causes green house effect in your premises but also affects the overall atmospheric
temperature.

Keeping these factors in mind , it is important to choose the right kind of insulation for your
premises. with 96% reflection ratio, thermal insulations are the most preferred kind of insulations
available in the market today.

## Why Alutix Insulation?

At Alutix, we produce Aluminium Air Bubble Insulation, which reflect(block) the radiant energy to
enter in your premise & thus help you maintain the temperature inside. Our manufacturing unit is
located in Raipur , Chhaattigarh.

The state of the art plant boasts of the world's finest thermal insulation manufacturing machines
with High-Speed production facility backed by the dedicated and experienced teams of motivated
members.

Our production process uses the most efficient method of manufacturing insulation material which
helps us to offer superior & consistent quality products at a competitive price.

### How much does attic insulation cost in Arizona?

R-value. SRP customers get up to **$600 off instantly**, and we file the rebate for you — so many
homeowners pay well under $2,000.

### Do I qualify for the SRP or APS insulation rebate?

If you’re an SRP or APS residential customer with less than ~7 inches of attic insulation, you
almost certainly qualify. We verify eligibility during your free inspection and submit all paperwork
on your behalf.

### Will a mini-split cool my hot garage or back room?

Yes. A ductless mini-split is the most efficient way to cool a garage, casita, or that one room
that’s always too hot — no ductwork required. Most single-zone installs are completed in a single
day.

Prevent energy loss, control condensation, regulate temperature, and protect those who come in

gas. From our headquarters in Stockholm to our factory in Poland, we work across international
markets to innovate and launch products designed to make a meaningful impact on the world.

With a diverse and inclusive working environment, we welcome talent from all backgrounds and
cultures to join us in advancing the next generation of home energy solutions.

## Custom Product Development

Since the beginning, Dunmore has utilized an evolving stage gate development process. The stage gate
system is a road-map to efficiently and effectively take your ideas and turn them into commercial
products. Dunmore's drive to create and innovate has led to an extensive technology portfolio. Our
range of technology, combined with our [collaborative approach to development][119] brings your
project to life.

## About DUNMORE

For more than 50 years, the Dunmore brand has stood for quality in [coated][120], [laminated][121]
and [metalized films][122]. During that time, several diverse industries have come to know our name,
as a [films manufacturer / coated films manufacturer][123], for outstanding standard and specialty
products. Today, they often turn to us first with new challenges untried innovations and
experimental applications.

## how we stand out

### PROVEN DURABILITY

Real-life membrane samples are consecutively tested by the external laboratory Belgian Building
Research Institute (BBRI) an supervised by independent quality-control organisation SGS
International in different continents and climate zones.

The life expectancy of our [waterproofing membranes][75] is currently 25 to 35 years based on the
actual condition of exposed DuO membranes worldwide.

### LOCAL EXPERTISE

Enduroflex is based in Sydney’s Northern Beaches and has been servicing  Australia with
DuO waterproofing membranes. DuO has been installed in Australia and New Zealand for more than 15
years.

The product is developed and adapted to withstand the local climate conditions and is fully aligned
with local application procedures, standards and regulations.

for Diesel and Gas Engines, Exhaust Systems, and Industrial Applications

[[Browse Our Engine Library]][194]

## Who We Are

Firwin Corporation is a leading manufacturer of custom insulation products for diesel and gas
engines, exhaust systems, and a variety of industrial applications. Our three primary product lines
include: removable and reusable insulation blankets (also known as insulation covers or jackets),
permanent Hard Coat™ composite insulation, and our Metal Foil Insulation (MFI) solutions, ideal for
applications requiring a lightweight, durable, and easy-to-clean insulation barrier. We also
maintain a broad inventory of off-the-shelf high-temperature tapes and sleeves to meet diverse
thermal protection needs.

### Insulation Installation Services

Our installation services focus on maximizing energy efficiency in your home or business. We use
advanced spray foam technology to create a complete seal that stops unwanted air movement and helps
maintain steady indoor temperatures. Our ProFoam Certified technicians assess each space carefully
to develop the best insulation plan, ensuring full coverage in attics, walls, crawl spaces, and
other important areas. The owner's involvement in every project guarantees careful attention to
detail and adherence to quality standards.
[ Learn More ][80]

### Insulation Removal Services

Removing outdated or damaged insulation is essential for improving your home's energy performance.
Our removal services include safe extraction of existing materials, proper disposal, and thorough
cleaning before installing new insulation. We carefully address any mold, pest issues, or moisture
damage discovered during the removal process. Our thorough approach ensures your space is properly
prepared for new, efficient insulation.

complete solution. We evaluate your existing insulation, identify problem areas, and suggest
appropriate replacement options that fit your needs and budget. Our team manages the entire process
from removal to installation, ensuring a smooth transition to better energy efficiency. With our
liability insurance and construction expertise, your insulation replacement will be completed safely
and correctly.

### Insulation Installation Services

Our installation services focus on maximizing energy efficiency in your home or business. We use
advanced spray foam technology to create a complete seal that stops unwanted air movement and helps
maintain steady indoor temperatures. Our ProFoam Certified technicians assess each space carefully
to develop the best insulation plan, ensuring full coverage in attics, walls, crawl spaces, and
other important areas. The owner's involvement in every project guarantees careful attention to
detail and adherence to quality standards.

### Insulation Removal Services

Removing outdated or damaged insulation is essential for improving your home's energy performance.
Our removal services include safe extraction of existing materials, proper disposal, and thorough
cleaning before installing new insulation. We carefully address any mold, pest issues, or moisture
damage discovered during the removal process. Our thorough approach ensures your space is properly
prepared for new, efficient insulation.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

INSTALLED BUILDING PRODUCTS

# We’re national.
# We’re local.
# But mostly,
# we’re people.

## Who we are.

Installed Building Products is the premier installation contractor for insulation for residential
and commercial builders with over 10,000 employees serving more than 250 locations nationwide.

As a national organization, we have access to the best products and training available. This,
combined with our exceptional local talent, empowers us to both impact our communities and provide
the highest quality service to our customers every day.

[ WHO WE ARE ][51]

## What we do.

Building on years of experience and hard work, IBP gets the job done.

Every day, our employees across the nation work with builders to meet their installation needs. We
install insulation, rain gutters, garage doors and other products that make a house feel like a
home. And from the first day on the job to the last, IBP leaves no stone unturned, providing
unmatched customer service and quality work in every project we tackle.

[ WHAT WE DO ][52]

#### INSULATION

#### GARAGE DOORS

#### RAIN GUTTERS

#### CLOSET SHELVING

#### SHOWER DOORS, MIRRORS,
#### AND BATH HARDWARE

#### WINDOW BLINDS

#### FIREPLACES

#### DOOR LOCKSETS AND
#### HARDWARE

## Join our team.

At IBP, we invest in all of our employees. That means robust benefits, a longevity stock program,
and the IBP Foundation, which offers scholarships, emergency assistance and volunteer matching for
everyone in the IBP family.

As a fast-paced, growing company, we’re always on the lookout for dedicated and talented installers
who share our “It’s Hard Work and I Love It” motto to join our team. Are you ready to see what IBP
has to offer?

[ JOIN OUR TEAM ][53]

INSTALLED BUILDING PRODUCTS

# We’re national.
# We’re local.
# But mostly,
# we’re people.

## Who we are.

Installed Building Products is the premier installation contractor for insulation for residential
and commercial builders with over 10,000 employees serving more than 250 locations nationwide.

As a national organization, we have access to the best products and training available. This,
combined with our exceptional local talent, empowers us to both impact our communities and provide
the highest quality service to our customers every day.

[ WHO WE ARE ][51]

## What we do.

Building on years of experience and hard work, IBP gets the job done.

Every day, our employees across the nation work with builders to meet their installation needs. We
install insulation, rain gutters, garage doors and other products that make a house feel like a
home. And from the first day on the job to the last, IBP leaves no stone unturned, providing
unmatched customer service and quality work in every project we tackle.

[ WHAT WE DO ][52]

#### INSULATION

#### GARAGE DOORS

#### RAIN GUTTERS

#### CLOSET SHELVING

#### SHOWER DOORS, MIRRORS,
#### AND BATH HARDWARE

#### WINDOW BLINDS

#### FIREPLACES

#### DOOR LOCKSETS AND
#### HARDWARE

## Join our team.

At IBP, we invest in all of our employees. That means robust benefits, a longevity stock program,
and the IBP Foundation, which offers scholarships, emergency assistance and volunteer matching for
everyone in the IBP family.

As a fast-paced, growing company, we’re always on the lookout for dedicated and talented installers
who share our “It’s Hard Work and I Love It” motto to join our team. Are you ready to see what IBP
has to offer?

[ JOIN OUR TEAM ][53]

## What Is R-Value in Insulation?

R-value measures thermal resistance—the ability of insulation to resist heat flow. The higher the
R-value, the greater the insulating effectiveness. R-value is expressed as h·ft²·°F/BTU in the
United States, representing the temperature difference needed to transfer one BTU of heat per hour
through one square foot of material.

The R-value you need depends on three factors: your climate zone (determined by heating and cooling
degree days), the location being insulated (attic, walls, basement, etc.), and local building codes.
The International Energy Conservation Code (IECC) establishes minimum R-value requirements, though
many energy-conscious homeowners exceed these minimums for better comfort and energy savings.

R-values are additive when materials are layered. For example, R-19 fiberglass batts plus R-11 batts
equals R-30 total. However, compression reduces R-value—a compressed R-19 batt performs below its
rated value. Proper installation without compression, gaps, or voids is essential for achieving
rated performance.

## **Creating a better world**

by transforming the energy industry through our sustainable and advanced solutions.

# **POWERING BETTER DECISIONS**

The Insulator Education Initiative offers practical, expert-backed resources to guide your team in
choosing the right solutions.

[ Visit Education Hub ][12]

THE INSULATOR EDUCATION INITIATIVE

### **BETTER INSULATOR DECISIONS START WITH BETTER INFORMATION**

As grid demands grow and conditions get tougher, choosing the right insulator is more critical than
ever.

The **Insulator Education Initiative** delivers clear, practical resources to help technical teams
make informed, confident decisions.

From comparison tables and explainer videos to technical articles and online tools, our content is
built to support engineers, buyers, and specifiers at every stage.

[ Visit Hub ][13]

Who we are

## Insulation Technology Group

**Insulation Technology Group** is an experienced international holding company operating in the
market segments of manufacturing **HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators**.

The corporation includes three major global brands **[LAPP Insulators][14], [PPC
Insulators][15], **and[** Cerisol**][16], produced in 8 manufacturing plants in Europe and North and
South America.

Our focus on the customer´s goals and the ability to provide both tailor-made insulation solutions
and standardized ones, with our engineering and technical support, makes us the preferred choice
when utilities, distributors, and contractors want to have a reliable insulator partner.

Sustainability is one of our key values that drives the design of our products, manufacturing, and
full supply chain processes.

[ Learn more ][17]
[INSULATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP - manufacture HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators]
[insulationtg Sustainability - Porcelain insulators]

### **Environmental responsibility**

ITG aimes to be a forerunner in the circular economy with **recyclable products and sustainable
manufacturing**.

**Porcelain insulators** are a very green option.

They are produced from the green and natural local raw materials.

They have a very long lifetime.

They are produced with 100% recyclability with low carbon  footprint and without hazards after the
end of life.

[INSULATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP - manufacture HV and MV electrical porcelain insulators]

In case of any questions or incentives regarding compliance, please contact us at the following
email address [compliance@insulationtg.com][18] or send us your message via the contact form.

# Olemme avoinna palvelemassa rakennusprojektejanne!

# PROFIILI

**I**solina yhtiöt kehittää, valmistaa ja markkinoi pellavapohjaisia tuotteita.
Pellavakuitu sisältää ominaisuuksia, jotka tekevät siitä ihanteellisen raaka-aineen
eristysmateriaalina:
se hengittää, absorboi ja luovuttaa liiallista kosteutta.

**P**ellavaa on käytetty tekstiilikuituna tuhansia vuosia. Vanhin pellavaharsolöytö on tehty
Egyptissä
7000 vuotta sitten.
On olemassa noin 200 eri pellavalajia. Lehdet ovat ohuita, kukat sinisiä, punaisia, valkoisia tai
keltaisia. Kauniista sinisistä pelloista, jotka auttavat pitämään maisemat avoinna, syntyy tehokasta
lämmöneristettä taloihimme.

**P**äätuotteitamme ovat monenlaiset lämmön- ja ääneneristeet.

**T**uotteemme ovat pellavapohjaisia, joiden valmistus pohjautuu ympäristötietoiseen ajatteluun.

[ISOLINA linen insulation; pellevaeriste; nauhat; linisolering; linull; drev; linisolasjon;
laftevatt]

# EDUT
1. hengittävät rakenteet
2. luonnonkuitu: luontaisetu
3. parempi sisäilman laatu
4. kestävä rakenne

**A**ikaisemmin talot olivat heikosti eristettyjä, mutta ne hengittivät.
Tällöin energiaa hukattiin paljon, mutta sisäilman laatu oli monissa tapauksissa parempi kuin
nykyisin.
Nykyiset talot rakennetaan yleensä hyvin eristettyinä, mutta muovisten höyrynsulkukalvojen ja
puutteellisen ilmanvaihdon yhteisvaikutuksesta sisäilman laatu heikkenee. Lisäksi rakenteisiin,
tavalla tai toisella, päässyt kosteus aiheuttaa riskin kosteusvauriolle ja rakenteiden
vaurioitumiselle.

**P**ellavaeriste tarjoaa molempien aikakausien hyvät ominaisuudet:
hyvän lämmön- ja ääneneristyksen, yhdistettynä pellavakuidulle ominaiseen kosteuden hengityskykyyn
seinä- ja kattorakenteissa, mahdollistaen rakenteiden hengittävyyden kastumatta.

### Why Insulation

[Professional insulation services and energy efficiency solutions for residential and commercial
properties.]

Insulation does more than just save energy. Here’s why proper insulation is a smart choice for any
home or business:

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Better Energy Efficiency

Better insulation means money saved and less surprises when it comes to your energy bill. 44% of the
home’s energy use is for heating and cooling the house, but without proper insulation your AC and
heat are going right out the door along with your money spent on energy bills. Proper insulation of
your home’s attic and floors can reduce your monthly energy expenses by 15% on average. We make your
home energy efficient, which is great for your comfortability and the environment!

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Comfort for your Home Year-Round

Enjoy a comfortable home year round, whether it’s a hot summer day or below freezing. Insulation
will help keep your house at the temperature on your thermostat, with no temperature variations
between rooms or floors. Insulation will also give your HVAC a break, requiring less energy to
achieve comfort!

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Protect Your Family from Mold, Allergens, and Fire

Insulation, Air Sealing, and Crawlspace Encapsulations create a moisture barrier, keeping moisture,
mold and allergens out of your home. The lack of proper insulation can also be a fire hazard. Enjoy
your home stress free by knowing that you and your family are protected!

### Why Insulation

[Professional insulation services and energy efficiency solutions for residential and commercial
properties.]

Insulation does more than just save energy. Here’s why proper insulation is a smart choice for any
home or business:

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Better Energy Efficiency

Better insulation means money saved and less surprises when it comes to your energy bill. 44% of the
home’s energy use is for heating and cooling the house, but without proper insulation your AC and
heat are going right out the door along with your money spent on energy bills. Proper insulation of
your home’s attic and floors can reduce your monthly energy expenses by 15% on average. We make your
home energy efficient, which is great for your comfortability and the environment!

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Comfort for your Home Year-Round

Enjoy a comfortable home year round, whether it’s a hot summer day or below freezing. Insulation
will help keep your house at the temperature on your thermostat, with no temperature variations
between rooms or floors. Insulation will also give your HVAC a break, requiring less energy to
achieve comfort!

[Professional insulation installation service for residential or commercial property improvement.]
Protect Your Family from Mold, Allergens, and Fire

Insulation, Air Sealing, and Crawlspace Encapsulations create a moisture barrier, keeping moisture,
mold and allergens out of your home. The lack of proper insulation can also be a fire hazard. Enjoy
your home stress free by knowing that you and your family are protected!

Application: HVAC
QUICK WORK OF DUCT WORK
HVAC systems are used in both commercial and residential buildings — from offices to factories,
hotels to homes. Adding HVAC insulation can help improve overall comfort and even lead to lower
utility costs.
[ Learn More ][134]
Application: Pipes
BETTER PROCESS CONTROL
Proper performance and safety are top of mind when it comes to pipe insulation. Installing it can
lead to more effective operation, reduce overall operating costs and even provide protection.
[ Learn More ][135]
Application: Attics
Step Up to the Attic
Attics — one of the most popular home-improvement projects for both DIYers and professional
contractors. Adding insulation to the attic is an easy and proven way to increase home comfort and
decrease energy costs.
[ Learn More ][136]
Application: Ceiling
Above Your Head
Whether it’s in your home or a commercial building, ceiling insulation can create a more comfortable
environment. It delivers excellent noise control, as well as thermal resistance that could help save
on heating and cooling bills.
[ Learn More ][137]
Application: Walls
The Walls Around Us
Increase the overall comfort of your home with wall insulation. It can reduce room-to-room sound
transmission. Thanks to the insulation's thermal performance, temperatures are maintained, reducing
energy loss and energy costs.
[ Learn More ][138]
Application: Mid-Floor
Just Between Us
Mid-floor insulation will help you meet the NFPA13 fire code. By properly insulating between floors
with a non-combustible material, your space won’t require a sprinkler system.
[ Learn More ][139]
Application: Floor
A Strong Foundation
There’s often noise associated with floors above another living area. Floor insulation can help
minimize that noise transfer. Beyond sound control, it even offers thermal performance.
[ Learn More ][140]
Application: Basement & Crawlspace
From the Bottom, Up
The basement — typically known for being a cold space. But with the proper insulation, all that can
change. Basement insulation can actually improve indoor home comfort and even save you money on
energy costs.
[ Learn More ][141]
Application: Air Sealing
Seal it Up
Leaks and drafts can make your home atmosphere a miserable one. Filling voids and cracks where air
can leak into your home can increase home comfort, decrease energy costs and make for a healthier
indoor structure.
[ Learn More ][142]

Why Choose Mooney & Moses Contractors?

At Mooney & Moses, **integrity, expertise, and exceptional service** are more than just
promises—they define how we work. Whether you're a homeowner seeking energy-efficient solutions or a
builder looking for reliable installations, our team delivers **high-quality products and unmatched
craftsmanship** you can trust.


**Comprehensive Home Solutions**
Looking to improve your home's **comfort, efficiency, and curb appeal**? We specialize in**
professional insulation installation, durable garage doors, and reliable gutter systems,** tailored
to meet your needs. From reducing energy costs to enhancing your home’s aesthetics, Mooney & Moses
is your** trusted partner for home improvement.**

# Insulation Contractors Serving Cincinnati, Ohio

Mooney & Moses has been serving the Cincinnati area with a high-quality level of installed products
and services since 1949. Mooney & Moses knows that a job is only as good as the crew that does it,
and that’s what makes us different—attention to detail, technical expertise and a commitment to
quality.

Whether you need [home insulation][64], [commercial insulation][65] or anything in between, we seek
your satisfaction and take our customer relationships very seriously.

## Professional Insulation Contractors Offering Top-Quality Insulation Materials

No matter what your home or commercial insulation needs are, Mooney & Moses has you covered. We
offer different types of insulation for new construction and retrofit projects, including:
* [Fiberglass][66]
* [Cellulose][67]
* [Spray foam][68]
* [Radiant barrier][69]
* [Rigid board foam][70]
* [Vinyl ][71]

In addition to the highest-quality insulation products, Mooney & Moses offers excellent customer
service. If you’re looking for a great insulation company in Cincinnati, don’t hesitate to give us a
call!

## Residential Insulation for New Construction & Retrofit Projects

Are your energy bills higher than normal? We have found that insulation is one of the best ways to
increase the energy efficiency and comfort of Cincinnati homes all year long. Our team can also
insulate many different spaces of your Cincinnati home, including:
* [Attic][72]
* [Basement][73]
* [Crawl space][74]
* [Floors][75]
* [Garage][76]
* [Walls][77]

## Commercial Insulation

Mooney & Moses has worked with many local builders, contractors and remodelers on new building
construction and addition projects. We have experience insulating different types of commercial
buildings, including:
* [Industrial construction][78]
* [Metal buildings][79]
* [Warehouses][80]

Re-insulating your business or office space can help decrease overhead costs and keep workers more
comfortable. Our team can help you determine which type of insulation is needed.

# Smart Research

North Data provides easily understandable company information that is publicly available, obtained
from sources such as trade registers, yearly reports, funding registers, trademark registers, patent
registers and others.

### For Professionals

North Data’s [Premium Services][22] are used by professionals, from all sectors, for detailed
research and financial analyses. Our powerful [Data Services][23] are used by our customers to
expand their databases and complement their products with meaningful company information and
visualizations.

### For Everybody

North Data's free online search engine offers a powerful freely accessible compilation of
[European][24] companies information, including history, financial indicators, involved persons, and
much more. Use the search box at the top of this page to specifically search for companies or
people.

[Country Coverage][25]

### New Countries and Sources

At North Data, we continuously work on adding new countries and sources to our data. Recently, we
added **Portugal**, **Ireland**, and the **Netherlands** to our list of supported countries.
Currently, we're working on more countries, and deepening the data coverage for the existing ones.

North Data provides easily understandable company information that is publicly available, obtained
from sources such as trade registers, yearly reports, funding registers, trademark registers, patent
registers and others.

### For Professionals

North Data’s [Premium Services][22] are used by professionals, from all sectors, for detailed
research and financial analyses. Our powerful [Data Services][23] are used by our customers to
expand their databases and complement their products with meaningful company information and
visualizations.

[European][24] companies information, including history, financial indicators, involved persons, and
much more. Use the search box at the top of this page to specifically search for companies or
people.

## Quick Answersfor You

Quick answers to your pressing questions.

## [Q: Are you a trader or manufacturer?][50] 

A: We are a manufacturer of composite insulating papers (DMD, NMN, AMA etc) and insulating sleeves,
with our own factory and production lines. At the same time, we have established strong strategic
partnerships with other material manufacturers, enabling us to act as your one-stop sourcing
consultant, efficiently meeting your diverse product needs.

## [Q: How about MOQ?][51] 

A: The standard minimum order quantity(MOQ) is usually 100~1000kg, also depends on products. For
customized products, the specific quantity can be negotiated.

## [Q: What are the lead time, packing method, shipping options, and after-sales solution for
## quality issues?][52] 

A: Lead time and shipping method depend on product type, quantity, processing requirements, and
destination. Normally 7~30 days. Standard materials usually have a shorter lead time, while
customized machined parts or bulk orders require a longer production period. For packing, we use
moisture-proof, pressure-resistant, and packaging according to product characteristics, such as
pallets.

## [Q: Can you provide samples for testing?][53] 

A: Yes. We are happy to provide free samples to potential customers with specific project needs.
Please tell us your specific application and testing requirements so that we can recommend the most
suitable model and arrange for sample delivery.

partnerships with other material manufacturers, enabling us to act as your one-stop sourcing
consultant, efficiently meeting your diverse product needs.

## [Q: How about MOQ?][51] 

A: The standard minimum order quantity(MOQ) is usually 100~1000kg, also depends on products. For
customized products, the specific quantity can be negotiated.

## [Q: What are the lead time, packing method, shipping options, and after-sales solution for
## quality issues?][52] 

A: Lead time and shipping method depend on product type, quantity, processing requirements, and
destination. Normally 7~30 days. Standard materials usually have a shorter lead time, while
customized machined parts or bulk orders require a longer production period. For packing, we use
moisture-proof, pressure-resistant, and packaging according to product characteristics, such as
pallets.

## [Q: Can you provide samples for testing?][53] 

Please tell us your specific application and testing requirements so that we can recommend the most
suitable model and arrange for sample delivery.

About us

## More than 130 years’ experience

PPC Insulators is a technology leader and manufacturer of state-of-the-art electrical porcelain
insulators for overhead transmission lines, substations and electrostatic precipitator applications.
Traditional porcelain insulators originated in the late 19th century. These were further developed
in-house by PPC via its isostatic production technology, allowing production of high-quality
products with efficient designs, tightest tolerances and shorter lead times for applications up to
1,200kV AC and 1,100kV DC.

# FIRE, SOUND AND THERMAL INSULATION

# GREAT THERMAL INSULATION PROPERTIES

Also known as mineral wool, stone wool is created by spinning molten rock and minerals with steel
slag to create a cotton-candy-like wool product. Pressed into rolls and sheets, stone wool creates
an incredibly effective insulation with sound-absorbing and fire-resistant properties.

### It’s Efficient

STONE WOOL products derive their thermal properties from tiny pockets of air trapped within the
physical structures of the stone wool. This structure allows the insulation to keep hot air out in
hot climates and retain warmth in cold climates.

### It’s Safer

Stone wool is resistant to fire. So if a fire starts, it will delay the spread—giving you and your
family more time to escape.

### It’s Quieter

STONE WOOL is high-density and excellent at absorbing sound.

### It’s Moisture Repellent

STONE WOOL insulation naturally repels water and moisture, so the long-term thermal performance of
the insulation is not affected by water.

# FIRE, SOUND AND THERMAL INSULATION

# GREAT THERMAL INSULATION PROPERTIES

Also known as mineral wool, stone wool is created by spinning molten rock and minerals with steel
slag to create a cotton-candy-like wool product. Pressed into rolls and sheets, stone wool creates
an incredibly effective insulation with sound-absorbing and fire-resistant properties.

### It’s Efficient

STONE WOOL products derive their thermal properties from tiny pockets of air trapped within the
physical structures of the stone wool. This structure allows the insulation to keep hot air out in
hot climates and retain warmth in cold climates.

### It’s Safer

Stone wool is resistant to fire. So if a fire starts, it will delay the spread—giving you and your
family more time to escape.

### It’s Quieter

STONE WOOL is high-density and excellent at absorbing sound.

### It’s Moisture Repellent

STONE WOOL insulation naturally repels water and moisture, so the long-term thermal performance of
the insulation is not affected by water.

## Informazioni su FELIS

Produzione di tutti i tipi di prodotti in PTFE vergine **dal 1998**. Precisione e tecnologia
italiana ai prezzi più bassi d’Europa. I nostri prodotti in PTFE sono stati venduti e spediti in
oltre 20 paesi in tutto il mondo. Qualità garantita dalle principali certificazioni (come ISO 9001 –
conformità 2.1 – 2.2 – 3.1 – FDA – RoHS).

## Origini e primi sviluppi dal 1998

[lastre ptfe tondi ptfe nastro in ptfe guarnizioni in ptfe]

FELIS SRL Unipersonale è stata fondata nel 1998 dopo una lunga esperienza nel settore del PTFE
(Teflon) – un materiale difficile da lavorare e la cui tecnologia è padroneggiata solo da poche
aziende al mondo. Dopo approfonditi studi e formazione negli Stati Uniti e in Russia, FELIS SRL ha
acquisito il know-how necessario per entrare a far parte del ristretto gruppo di aziende produttrici
di PTFE. Sfruttando questa tecnologia ed esperienza, l’azienda ha iniziato a produrre PTFE sia sotto
forma di semilavorati che di prodotti finiti.

## About Us

Register Insulation, Inc. was founded in 1983 by Keith Register. His dream of having his own
business, coupled with his hard work ethic and a principle to always "do the job right", has turned
Register Insulation, Inc. into a thriving company for 40 years! This reality continues now with his
son, Chris Register, as the V.P. of Register Insulation, Inc. Our team has more than 65 full time
employees and our team of seasoned estimators and quality installers are here to tackle any job big
or small.

[IMG_2848.jpg]

# What We Offer

#### Heat & Ventilation

RK Insulation provides a complete service of design, manufacture and installation of insulation,
cladding, process heating and vents using highly experienced thermal insulation, mechanical and
electrical engineers.

#### Chilled Services

RK Insulation can oversee your cold room/store project through initial concept, design, erection of
the insulated cladding structure, installation of refrigeration systems and maintenance. RK
Insulation specializes in undertaking large cold rooms, cold stores, chilled storage & refrigerated
warehouse projects across India.

#### Frost Protection

Thermal Insulation can be used as a primary frost protection system for pipe work or vessels for
industrial use. We offer weatherproof finishes for external applications and can manufacture various
metal cladding for pipework and fittings.

#### Rigid Foam Insulation

RK Insulation installs rigid foam insulation for a variety of applications, including the attic,
basement and crawl space. Rigid foam is a popular insulating product for its durability, high
insulating value and versatility.

#### Dehumidification

RK Insulation industrial dryers operate reliably, thus preventing condensation, odor nuisance and
the spread of germs – the perfect humidity control essential for food industry. Protective clothing,
disinfection, compliance with the cold chain and other strict hygienic requirements are on the
agenda in the processing of fresh produce.

#### Acoustic Insulation

RK Insulation provides soundproofing consulting services designed around the full array of
acoustical sound panels and related soundproofing products you will discover right here on our
website. We start with the advice, then package the framework for your treatment around your budget,
and deliver the most cost effective soundproofing products on the market to your doorstep.

#### Noise Protection

RK Insulation has considerable expertise in designing acoustic insulation for a industrial/
shipping/ commercial infrastructures. Using structural drawings, engine characteristics and other
data, we can calculate and manufacture all the necessary noise protection, such as silencers and
sound-absorbing systems.

#### Blown in Insulation

As part of our installation service for attic insulation in India and surrounding areas, our
professionals will work with you to determine if blown insulation is the right insulation for your
home or project, and what the appropriate R-value for the property should be.

#### Cellulose Insulation

RK Insulation provides superb energy savings along with a significant reduction in air infiltration,
resulting in outstanding long-term value and return on investment. RK’ Cellulose Insulation is also
made of up to 85% Indian recycled materials, making RK one of the greenest insulations.

#### Steel & Condensate Pipework

RK Insulation undertakes insulation of pipe and duct systems to avoid condensation or to provide
personnel protection is required. We do Insulation of the complete system, which is required when
condensation is possible.

#### Refractory Lining

RK Insulation undertakes designing, supply, and installation of any type of refractory lining
required for power plants, petrochemicals and chemical units. Also, we undertake, vibro casting of
reactor, regenerator package including supply and installation.

#### Passive Fire Protection

RK Insulation’s undertake designing and manufacturing flexible passive fire protection systems to
fit the equipment’s/ cable tray etc. They give up to two hours protection against flame temperatures
in excess of 2012ºF. Our system enables a variety of materials to be selected in order to best meet
the customer specification. This ensures that the design can accommodate difficulties in location
and space restrictions.


#### R K INSULATION ENGINEERS & CONTRACTORS

RK Insulation Engineers & Contractors is a professional engineering driven entity, founded in 2002
with a view to specialize in Thermal insulation, Refrigeration & associated fields.

The company's facilities in Gujarat & Maharashtra both include 3000 square feet of office space, and
10,000 square feet of warehouse storage, in addition to a small office and warehouse at client
sites. With a 120-man crew working throughout the state of Gujarat, the Company has evolved to
become a reliable partner in the insulation, fire stop and fireproofing business.

Industrial

#### **Industrial Insulation: Why Insulate Piping Systems?**

There are numerous benefits to insulating piping in industrial facilities with fiberglass and
mineral wool insulation products including helping to keep piping systems stable and working safely.

##### **5 great reasons to insulate industrial piping systems**

##### **1. Increases Fire Protection
##### **

A huge benefit in California as wildfires have been more apparent. Fiberglass and mineral wool
insulation are inherently non-combustible.

##### **2. Prevents Condensation and Subsequent Corrosion on Cold Surfaces
##### **

Specifying sufficient insulation thickness with the right vapor retarder is the most effective means
of controlling condensation and limiting corrosion on cold piping, ducts, chillers, and roof drains.
Sufficient thickness is needed to keep the outermost surface temperature above the dew point
temperature of the ambient air.

##### **3. Controls Surface Temperature for Personnel Protection
##### **

Fiberglass and mineral wool insulation systems reduce the surface temperature of piping and
equipment to a safer level, reducing the risk of burns and worker downtime due to injury.

##### **4. Controls and Stabilizes Process Temperatures
##### **

By reducing heat loss or gain, fiberglass and mineral wool insulation help maintain process
temperature to your pre-determined value. Insulation that’s specified to proper thickness can limit
heat loss in a dynamic system or limit temperature drop over time in a static system.

##### **5. Controls Noise and Vibrations
##### **

Pipe insulation materials can be used to encase piping mechanisms that cause noises or vibrations,
forming a sound and vibration barrier between the piping and external areas.

#### **The Importance of Insulation for Commercial Buildings**

The role of insulation is to prevent the migration of heat from warmer spaces to cooler ones. This
is a very simple concept that affects both commercial and residential buildings in several
significant ways.
* **Reduces heating and cooling costs:** To keep up with temperature variations in a poorly
  insulated structure, your furnace, air conditioner, heat pump, or boiler will have to work
  overtime. Your HVAC equipment will have to provide extra cooling or heating to compensate for the
  loss or addition of heat, depending on the season. Not only will you lose the energy you’ve
  already paid for to create heating or cooling, but you’ll also have to pay for more energy to make
  up for the loss. This will lead to a significant waste of energy and money.
* **Helps maintain indoor comfort:** A well-insulated building will be much more comfortable than
  one that is poorly insulated. Without insulation, heat can escape the structure in the winter and
  enter during the summer. With the proper amount of insulation, this transfer of heat will be
  reduced or eliminated and your indoor spaces will stay at the temperature you prefer.
* **Decreases wear on HVAC systems:** As HVAC systems work overtime to compensate for the effects of
  limited insulation, they will experience more wear and tear than they would under better
  circumstances. This will increase the chances of a system malfunction or breakdown and the need
  for a costly repair. It will also shorten the functional life of the equipment, making it likely
  that a complete replacement will be necessary sooner than normal. The effectiveness of insulation
  is determined by its R-value, which is a measure of how well it resists the flow of heat.
  Different areas of the country require different R-values to achieve minimum insulation levels.
  Higher R-values mean more effective insulation.

Specifying sufficient insulation thickness with the right vapor retarder is the most effective means

Sufficient thickness is needed to keep the outermost surface temperature above the dew point
temperature of the ambient air.

##### **3. Controls Surface Temperature for Personnel Protection

Fiberglass and mineral wool insulation systems reduce the surface temperature of piping and
equipment to a safer level, reducing the risk of burns and worker downtime due to injury.

By reducing heat loss or gain, fiberglass and mineral wool insulation help maintain process
temperature to your pre-determined value. Insulation that’s specified to proper thickness can limit
heat loss in a dynamic system or limit temperature drop over time in a static system.

## Budujemy bezpieczeństwo dla zrównoważonego świata

Zwiększamy nasze zaangażowanie w rozwój zrównoważonego budownictwa. Uważnie śledzimy trendy i zmiany
w otaczającym nas świecie. Nieustannie pracujemy nad minimalizacją naszego wpływu na środowisko i
racjonalnym zarządzaniem zasobami. Jako spółka odpowiedzialna społecznie działamy na skalę
międzynarodową, tworząc bezpieczne miejsca pracy dla naszych pracowników.
[ Dowiedz się więcej ][33]

## Selena R&D – Badania i Rozwój

Tworzymy innowacyjne produkty zderzając nowoczesną naukę i potrzeby pracowników budowlanych. Nasze
laboratoria wyposażone są w wysokiej jakości sprzęt analityczny, co pozwala nam dogłębnie
analizować, testować i rozwijać produkty dla branży budowlanej. Łączymy technologie z różnych grup
produktowych tworząc nowe, nieznane dotychczas na rynku, rozwiązania.

energy efficiency, and safety. We aim to ensure that every product we offer helps businesses and

industry being reputed as one of the most reliable vendors in the sector. Over time our organisation
has emerged as a solution oriented and constantly evolving entity. Today we are on our way to

The Company is established as a brick manufacturing and sales unit in a newly independent India
looking at an infrastructure revolution

1950
1963

The family decides to go solo with the enterprise and the company is rechristened to Shah and Sons –
a family run business 

The company starts a logistics wing under the name “Amit Transport”

1974
1976-78

The company slowly phases out manufacturing operations to focus solely on trading and sales. The
logistics entity is brought under the same roof. The newly evolved organisation is named “Amit
Trading Corporation”

The 4th generation of the family business enters the company bringing in fresh perspectives and
innovation

2007-09
2009

## Rapid Insulation Removal & Install Services

[ Insulation Services ][49]

#### Attics

Enjoy an ideal climate in your home and save a ton on energy costs. We will take care of replacing
or adding to existing insulation. Minor repairs and air sealing are a pre-install option. Just let
us know what you need and we'll get the job done.

#### Crawl

Clean out debris in your crawl space and improve your home's air quality. We will handle the dirty
work so you don't have to. Our team can insulate your sub-floor, air ducts and floors in a single
day. We use "green" sanitation methods.

#### Basement

Keep your basement dry and protect mechanical equipment from the elements. We can insulate basements
and convert them into conditioned spaces. Create a climate controlled room for ultimate energy
effiency. Or, just protect you current living spaces better.

#### Walls

Most old properties walls are under-insulated. Reduce noise between rooms or protect from outside
elements. We can install wall insulation into existing walls or open frames. Choose from a wide
range of insulating options to best meet your goals.

#### Foam

Don't worry about the mess or headaches. Get the ultimate climate protection for your home or
business. Nothing competes with spray foam's r-value per square inch and air sealing. We use the
best equipment and closed-cell foam.

#### Commercial

No job is too big for us to handle. We've worked with businesses across the Puget Sound. Our team
has experience in new construction, facility upgrades and rental properties. We'll get the job done
on time and on budget.

#### Sound

Let SI help you meet your soundproofing goals. We have experience in both residential and commercial
installs. ROXUL's sound absorption insulation is among the finest available. Our team can help you
find the best solution for your challenge.

#### Retrofits

Remodeling a room or planning an entire custom home? Let us help you find what type of insulation
retrofit will work the best. We've worked with some of the top remodelers in the state. Our vetted
team is familiar with all the local building codes.

## Thin Film. Thick Film. Real Insulation Science Performance!

**SPI Coatings** is the only insulation-coating manufacturer that developed both **thin-film and
thick-film ceramic systems**, each engineered for a completely different heat-control function.

Thin films are designed to **block radiative** heat at the surface.

Thick films are designed to **hold and control conducted heat** on hot substrates.

They are not interchangeable.

No matter what a manufacturer claims, a thick coating cannot block radiative heat the way a properly
engineered thin ceramic film can. The physics doesn’t allow it.

Most insulation-coating suppliers only offer an average-performing thick film and market it as a
universal solution. Industry is now discovering the limitation.

Between 1989 and 1995, SPI Coatings worked directly with [NASA][146] in a six-year research program
led by the company’s founder, focusing on ceramic compound behaviour.

## Frequently asked questions
* Why do you recommend waterproofing?
  Water penetration can cause corrosion of steel reinforcements within structural elements, reducing
  the load-bearing capacity of a building. Over time, moisture leads to concrete cracking,
  deterioration, and structural damage. Proper waterproofing not only protects the structural
  integrity of a building but also prevents mold, bacteria growth, and unhealthy indoor conditions.
  It ensures a safe, durable, and comfortable living environment by eliminating leaks from roofs,
  foundations, and wet areas. .
* What is Bituminous waterproofing membrane?
  Bituminous waterproofing membranes are protective materials produced by modifying bitumen with
  polymer-based additives. They may be manufactured with or without reinforcement (such as polyester
  felt or fiberglass) to enhance mechanical strength and durability.
* What are the usage areas of bituminous waterproofing membranes?
  Bituminous membranes are used in areas exposed to water infiltration, including:
  * Foundations and basement walls
  * Retaining walls
  * Terraces and balconies
  * Flat and pitched roofs
  * Wet areas (bathrooms, WC, kitchens)
  * Water tanks, artificial lakes, and pools
  * Highways, bridges, viaducts, and railway systems
  * Parking decks and industrial flooring
  They provide reliable waterproofing in both residential and large-scale infrastructure projects.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

about the company

TECHNONICOL Corporation is a leading international producer of reliable and effective building
materials and systems. The company offers innovative products and technologies that combine
solutions of proper research centers and international experience.

The Corporation includes two large divisions, independently managed by each of the owners: the
TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, and the Trading Company "Technonicol
Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov.

The TECHNONICOL Industrial Company, headed by Sergey Kolesnikov, integrates 70+ production sites in
Russia and abroad, 19 training centers and 7 research centers equipped with high-tech equipment and
qualified personnel. The centers regularly develop and implement new products and solutions for the
construction industry.

Trading Company "Technonicol Trading Systems" managed by Igor Rybakov specializes in selling the
Corporation's products, but also other building materials and tools for industrial, civil and
private housing construction in more than 100 trade offices in Russia and the CIS.

The mission of TECHNONICOL is to produce high quality, reliable and effective construction materials
and solutions, which we strive to make available to every person in the world. Our team is guided by
principles of workmanship, high professionalism, responsibility and safety.

We are passionate about constant perfection of our materials, challenge met by our Research and
development centers. The company is constantly upgrading existing technologies and launching new
materials. Our Research centers and laboratories possess modern equipment to study physical and
mechanical properties of materials within a wide range of temperatures, define the structure and
ingredients of raw compounds and test the durability of finished products. Scientific research and
new technologies make it possible to launch several new products every year.

TECHNONICOL is among the first Russian companies to emphasize the need of educating builders in new
technologies and innovative material application. Our training centers offer modern equipment,
stands, models and spaces for hands-on training. Thanks to practical approach to learning, we give
additional educational support to our employees, customers and partners.

### **Injection Wall Foam**

Used on both exterior walls and interior walls, USA Premium Injection Foam is second to none. It is
injected into wall spaces with a fast application process, filling cracks and crevices that most
other insulation products can't. The insulation fills spaces behind electrical and phone wires,
pipes, electrical outlets, and other areas for maximum efficiency.

[More On Injection Foam][66]
[a man installing insulation in an attic]

### **Blown-In Attic Insulation**

When your attic is not properly insulated and ventilated, you can lose conditioned air quickly,
making your home more difficult - and more expensive - to keep comfortable during the winter as well
as the summer. In addition to letting heat escape during the cold winter months, a poorly insulated
attic is a major contributing factor in the formation of ice dams, icicles, and mold growth, which
can be both a health and safety hazard for your family and your property.

[More On Attic Insulation][67]
[a man working in an attic]

### **Air Sealing**

Our highly skilled, trained, and experienced energy and insulation experts can come to your home to
conduct our "Search and Seal" procedure. This process finds and targets the leaks that are hurting
your home's energy efficiency, and seals them off for energy use reduction!

[More On Air Sealing][68]
[a wooden wall cavity]

### **Spray Foam**

Spray polyurethane foam (SPF) is an innovative foam plastic substance that is sprayed onto an open
surface in paint-like form and then expands to create an insulating barrier against wind and outside
temperatures. Once the insulation sets, it expands to create an insulation barrier against extreme
temperatures and moisture.

[More on Spray Foam][69]

your home's energy efficiency, and seals them off for energy use reduction!

[More On Air Sealing][68]
[a wooden wall cavity]

### **Spray Foam**

Spray polyurethane foam (SPF) is an innovative foam plastic substance that is sprayed onto an open
surface in paint-like form and then expands to create an insulating barrier against wind and outside
temperatures. Once the insulation sets, it expands to create an insulation barrier against extreme
temperatures and moisture.

Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.

  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.

  Komfort.

## Our Products

We are the insulation manufacturing leader providing innovative and cost-effective insulation
solutions in Nigeria

[Insulated Roof]

### Insulated Roof

Vitapur’s insulated roofing panels consist of a top layer of aluminum sheet bonded to a polyurethane
foam core incorporating superior air-tightness and moisture control as well as a high R-value.

[ Learn about Insulated Roof ][58]
[[Pipe Insulation]][59]

### [Pipe Insulation][60]

Pre-cut pipe sections are used to insulate and protect heating and plumbing services within large
diameter pipe systems. Typically, it is used in municipal heating and offshore oil and gas
pipelines, process industries (food and beverage), power stations and refineries

[ Learn about Pipe Insulation ][61]
[[Rockwool Panel]][62]

### [Rockwool Panel][63]

Our Rockwool Panels are not just any ordinary sandwich panels; they are meticulously crafted using
high-density Rockwool cores embedded between two layers of Chromadek (pre-painted galvanized steel)
sheets.

[ Learn about Rockwool Panel ][64]
[[ISO Board]][65]

### [ISO Board][66]

Insulation boards are made of a polyurethane foam core which can be covered with a wide variety of
materials including Kraft paper, Naked, Mineral coated glass fibre tissue, Embossed aluminum foil,
and Bituminized paper.

[ Learn about ISO Board ][67]
[[Sandwich Panels]][68]

### [Sandwich Panel][69]

Vitapur Sandwich panels are cost-efficient prefabricated elements that consist of an inner
insulation core between two colour-coated steel sheet layers. The insulating core in the case of
Vitapur can be Polyurethane or polyisocyanurate.

[ Learn about Sandwich Panel ][70]
[[Sprayfoam Application]][71]

### [Spray Foam][72]

This is derived by on-site mixing of our two basic chemicals, MDI & Polyol; and spraying the
chemical in liquid form onto a surface for it to solidify. The spray foam expands to seal all cracks
and crevices, providing a seamless air barrier.

[ Learn about Spray Foam ][73]

### Refractories & High Temperature Insulation Materials

#### **Vitcas** is a manufacturer of [refractories][95], heat resistant products and high
#### temperature insulation materials which follows the tradition of refractory and heat resistant
#### manufacturing in Bristol, UK, **since 1882.**

Our product portfolio includes fire cements, fire bricks, refractory setting mortars and cements,
plastic mouldable refractories, zircon-based refractory materials, acid-resistant cements, and
refractory castables. These are engineered for use in a broad range of high-temperature industrial
applications, including steel and metallurgical plants, power and heat generation facilities,
ferrous and non-ferrous foundries, cement and lime production, glassworks, ceramics manufacturing,
coke plants, waste incineration units, renewable energy operations, chemical processing facilities,
sugar refineries, the aerospace industry, and the petrochemical sector.

### Revolutionary Hybrid System

Our Hybrid System combines the best of both worlds: the robust, non-respirable properties of Poly
Crystalline Wool (PCW) on the hot face, and the safe, Low Bio Persistence (LBP) fibers on the cold
face. The microporous interlayer optimally reduces heat transfer, ensuring that the LBP side remains
below 1050 °C, keeping it safe from forming  Respirable Crystalline Silica (RCS).

We are the leading manufacturer of high temperature board products which can be used in many
applications varying from backup behind a dense or insulating lining, in the heat exchanger of a
domestic boiler or for high temperature applications in ceramic kiln. Our state-of-the-art drying
techniques reduced energy consumption by 70% and allow us to manufacture a uniform, lightweight, low
shot and stable board to a thickness of 100 mm.

#### Best Thermal Insulation

ULS technology you have the option to optimize your lining thickness, but we challenge you to reduce
your energy consumption as well as you CO2 emission.

Independently tested, the SoliBlanket ULS-grade outperforms the ‘best in class’ Generation I and
Generation II fiber products with up to 30% improvement on thermal conductivity.

 

#### Toughest Tensile Strength

High temperature fiber blankets are ‘needled’ to convert from a fleece to a blanket. During the
needling process, interlocking for the fibers in the fiberstructure is achieved. High fiber index
and advanced needling technology are crucial to achieve the toughest tensile strength.

With typically 30% higher tensile strength compared to Generation II and 70% higher tensile strength
compared to Generation I fiber, our fiber is delivering the highest strength of all tested fiber
products.

#### Superior Handling

Superior Handling is perhaps our most import feature resulting from the Ultra Low Shot technology,
but the least easy to quantify in numbers. Because; How do you define less fiber dust when working
over head installing the product in the roof of a furnace??

Rest assured that your installation team installing the blankets can tell you the difference.
